BrochureContent.Content:
Located in the heart of Clonmel town centre, 16 Morton Street presents an excellent opportunity for investors seeking an income-producing property in a well-established residential location. This mid-terraced property is currently configured as two self-contained apartments and is being offered for sale with tenants in place, providing immediate rental income.

The accommodation is laid out as follows:

Apartment 1 (Ground Floor)
Open-plan Kitchen / Living Area, 1 Bedroom, Bathroom, and Small private rear yard

Apartment 2 (First & Second Floors)
Entrance Hallway, Open-plan Kitchen / Living Area, 2 Bedrooms, and Bathroom

Situated within walking distance of all town centre amenities including shops, schools, restaurants, public transport links, and local services, this property benefits from a highly convenient location.

This is an ideal opportunity for investors looking to acquire a multi-unit residential property with established tenancy arrangements and strong rental appeal in the centre of Clonmel.
